about.title: Ku njye
about.lead: Ni HIRWA Aime JOSPIN — nkitwa MC HAJ — Umushakashatsi wa Full-Stack ukomoka i Rusizi, mu Rwanda.
points: Nshimangira gukemura ibibazo, ubuhanga n'ubushya — nkora ibicuruzwa by'ikoranabuhanga mfite izera kuri byo.
Intego yange ni ukora inganda nyinshi z'ikoranabuhanga, kwaguka mu bushobozi, no kumenya byinshi kuri ordinateur n'ibikoresho by'imediya.
Nshobora gukora samwe cyangwa mu itsinda.
Shakisha akazi cyangwa internship, abakiriya ba freelance, n'abafatanyabikorwa bafite izera ku buziranenge.
